results.description:
What’s it take to overcome the odds and change the game? That’s at the heart of the warm and revealing conversations between epic NBA sharpshooters—and father and son—Dell and Stephen Curry in their Audible Original Heat Check. While Dell laid the groundwork, Stephen later delivered a whole new era of jaw-dropping three-pointers from a time previously dominated by flying dunks. In these episodes, we hear how Stephen experienced his life’s journey and how Dell saw it play out.

Get the inside story on how Stephen went from an underrated short and slim kid to dominating the league. Find out about the ties Stephen shares with superstar rival LeBron James, who was born in the same hospital in Akron, Ohio, and get the scoop on how Stephen was on his way to becoming a New York Knick but ultimately became a legendary Golden State Warrior. But, above all, hear how family is everything for the Currys, and learn what Dell had to sacrifice in order for his children to succeed.

Guest voices include Stephen's mother, Sonya, who always has his back; fellow little man yet big-time baller (and Stephen's mentor) Muggsy Bogues; savvy agent to both Stephen and Dell, Jeff Austin; and more. Ready to discover how to catch fire in life and on the court? Let’s get it!
